candidates.rationale: An individual agency feed from the regional data hub. Transitland imports the region from the hub's combined feed instead, so these are deliberately not registered. A few are registered anyway at client request and carry tags marking them fetched but not imported; this covers the rest, whose agencies are all present through the combined feed.
